manifest.description: Automated broadcast-grade audio mixing and mastering for YouTube. Features auto-ducking sidechain compression to smoothly attenuate background music (-12dB to -18dB) when speech occurs, vocal conditioning (80Hz high-pass filter, 3.5kHz clarity EQ, dynamic leveler), precise YouTube loudness normalization (-14 LUFS, -1.0 dBTP True Peak), and direct video multiplexing without re-encoding.

bgm_file.description: Path to the background music audio file to be ducked under the voice (e.g. 'bgm.mp3', 'soundtrack.wav').

ducking_depth.description: Sidechain ducking intensity: 'mild' (-10dB attenuation), 'standard' (-14dB attenuation, recommended), or 'deep' (-18dB attenuation for heavy podcasts).

enable_vocal_eq.description: Enable vocal conditioning chain: 80Hz high-pass filter and 3.5kHz clarity boost (default: true).

keywords.description: Mandatory on the first tool call of a turn: Comma-separated technical domain keywords in English.

output_file.description: Destination file path for the mixed master audio or video (e.g. 'master_youtube.wav', 'final.mp3', 'video_mux.mp4').

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.

target_lufs.description: Target integrated loudness in LUFS according to YouTube standards (default: -14.0).

video_file.description: Optional: Path to a raw video file. If supplied, the mixed audio is multiplexed with this video using stream copy (-c:v copy) without re-encoding video frames.

voice_file.description: Path to the primary speech/voiceover audio or video file (e.g. 'narration.wav', 'mic.mp3', 'clip.mp4').

tools.name: youtube_audio_mixer
